findings.evidence: TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/UniversalEnveloping/PBW/Basic.lean:77-84 `def pbwFiltration (k : ℕ) : Submodule R U := TauCeti.Algebra.wordFiltration (ι R).toLinearMap k` and `theorem pbwFiltration_def ... := (rfl)`; Functoriality.lean:109 `(map R f).toLinearMap.restrict fun _ hx => map_mem_pbwFiltration R f hx` vs Functoriality.lean:245 `(map R f).toLinearMap.restrict fun x hx => ...` (the restrict proof is a Prop, so the two terms are defeq).
findings.fix: Delete the three private declarations; in `mapGradedPiece` pass `mapFiltration R f k` to `Submodule.mapQ` (its type `↥(pbwFiltration R L k) →ₗ[R] ↥(pbwFiltration R M k)` unifies with `↥(wordFiltration ιL k) →ₗ[R] ↥(wordFiltration ιM k)` by unfolding `pbwFiltration`; add a type ascription if elaboration needs a nudge), and replace `mapWordFiltration_id`/`mapWordFiltration_comp` in the proofs of `mapGradedPiece_id` (306) and `mapGradedPiece_comp` (315) by `mapFiltration_id`/`mapFiltration_comp`.
findings.issue: `mapWordFiltration` (242), `mapWordFiltration_id` (251) and `mapWordFiltration_comp` (259) duplicate the public `mapFiltration` (107), `mapFiltration_id` (118) and `mapFiltration_comp` (128) in the same file: `pbwFiltration R L k` is by definition `wordFiltration (ι R).toLinearMap k`, and both defs are literally `(map R f).toLinearMap.restrict _`.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/DirectSum/Ring.lean:560 `theorem toSemiring_of (f : ∀ i, A i →+ R) (hone hmul) (i : ι) (x : A i) : toSemiring f hone hmul (of _ i x) = f _ x`; mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/DirectSum/Algebra.lean:120-121 `toAlgebra` is built as `{ toSemiring (fun i => (f i).toAddMonoidHom) hone @hmul with toFun := toSemiring ... }`.
findings.fix: Prove it from `DirectSum.toSemiring_of ... k x` (followed by `DirectSum.lof_eq_of` to turn `lof` into `of`) and drop the `change`/comment.
findings.issue: `mapAssociatedGraded_of` re-derives the `of`-computation of `DirectSum.toAlgebra` by `change`-ing to `DirectSum.toAddMonoid` and applying `toAddMonoid_of`; the comment at 366-367 claiming no computation lemma exists is wrong — `DirectSum.toSemiring_of` is exactly that lemma, and `toAlgebra`'s `toFun` is `toSemiring (fun i => (f i).toAddMonoidHom) hone hmul`.

summary: The new private `mapWordFiltration` and its two lemmas are the public `mapFiltration`, `mapFiltration_id`, `mapFiltration_comp` from the same file up to unfolding `pbwFiltration` (whose defining equation is `rfl`). Separately, `mapAssociatedGraded_of` re-derives Mathlib's `DirectSum.toSemiring_of`.
